title: Output sharing via --output_user_root is broken

labels.name: P1
labels.description: I'll work on this now. (Assignee required)

labels.name: team-Local-Exec
labels.description: Issues and PRs for the Execution (Local) team

body:
### Description of the problem / feature request:

bug: fatal error when start bazel with --output_user_root=/data/tmp/

```
$ bazel --output_user_root=/data/tmp build [other options and the target]
FATAL: mkdir('/data/tmp/'): (error: 13): Permission denied
```

### Bugs: what's the simplest, easiest way to reproduce this bug? Please provide a minimal example if possible.

I want multiple users to share the same execution directory, so they can share one build process and the cache file is still saved after any user destroys itself.
the /data/ and /data/tmp/ is already created by the root user, and /data/tmp/ has setted to 777.
May be 'mkdir' should not be executed on the existing directory?

```
$ ll /data
total 828
drwxrwxrwx 19 root root   4096 Oct  9 11:46 ccache
drwxrwxrwx  2 root root   4096 Dec  7 15:33 corefile
drwxr-xr-x  4 root root   4096 Oct 29 20:18 home
drwx------  2 root root  16384 Mar  7  2018 lost+found
drwxrwxrwx  4 root root 815104 Dec  8 14:32 tmp
```

### What operating system are you running Bazel on?

CentOS 7 x86_64

### What's the output of `bazel info release`?

release 0.19.1

### If `bazel info release` returns "development version" or "(@non-git)", tell us how you built Bazel.

only 'release 0.19.1'. installed from the script "bazel-0.19.1-installer-linux-x86_64.sh" in the release page.

 I have tried google 'bazel output_user_root mkdir' but have not found solution.
